ES Arena as a desktop app: The Elder Scrolls: Arena (1994), remade by AI in Three.js. You play it with the game files from your own copy of Arena, which is free on Steam.

## What's new in {version}

{changes}

## Download

Pick the zip for your computer. The "Source code" files below are for programmers, not for playing.

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or newer) | ES-Arena-{version}-Mac-Apple-silicon.zip |
| Mac with an Intel chip | ES-Arena-{version}-Mac-Intel.zip |
| Windows PC | ES-Arena-{version}-Windows.zip |

Not sure which Mac you have? Choose About This Mac from the Apple menu: it lists a "Chip" for Apple and a "Processor" for Intel.

The app needs macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer, or Windows 10 or newer.

## Opening it

**Mac:** double-click the zip to unzip it, then double-click ES Arena (you can move it into Applications first). The first time, macOS says it could not verify the app, because it isn't signed with a paid Apple developer certificate. Click Done, open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, scroll down to the message about ES Arena and click Open Anyway.

**Windows:** right-click the zip, choose Extract All, then open the new folder and double-click ES Arena. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway.

When the game opens, click **Choose ARENA folder…** and pick the `ARENA` folder from your copy of Arena, the one that holds `GLOBAL.BSA`. The app remembers it after that.
